book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: God i wande luk ip Eibram i prapa bilib wea Em
Wen Eibram i bin stap de gudwail, God i bin meke samting po em po luk ip em i stil bilib lo God. God i bin spik po em, ‘Eibram!’ Ane Eibram i ansa gobaigen po God, ‘Wa. Ai ya AntapGod. Wiswei?’

‘Boi blo yu, Aizak, wea yu prapa gad tumas lab po em, yutu mas go po da ples wea ol pipol kolem Moria. Wen yutu kesem de, yu mas kile boi blo yu ane banem antap lo olta po wosip mi. Yu mas mekem lo wan maunten wea ai go soe yu.’

Prapa elimoning, neksdei, Eibram bin gedap prom slip, ane meke dongki redi, teke tu sebant, ane teke boi blo em, Aizak. Em bin kate paiwud po da banopring, ane ol i bin lego go po da ples wea God i bin soe em po go.
Lo namba tri dei wen ol bin stil wagbaut, Eibram i bin luk ane em bin tekenotis da maunten bat i bin stil longwei.
Den Eibram bin spik diskain po tu sebant blo em, ‘Stap ya wea dem dongki. Mi ane boiwan go lego go de. Mitu go wosip God, den mitu go kambaigen po yutu.’
Eibram bin teke paiwud po banopring ane bin gibem po Aizak po karem, ane em emselp bin kare da naip ane ot asis po state da paia. Wa! Demtu bin wagbaut go tugeda.

Aizak spik po papa blo em, ‘Papa?’ Ane Eibram ansarem, ‘Wiswei mai boi?’ Ane Aizak spik po papa blo em, ‘Prapa tru. Yumi gad ot asis po state paia ane yumi gad naip, bat wea da smolsip po kilem ane banem antap lo olta.’
Eibram i bin ansa, ‘Mai boi, God emselp i go gibe da smolsip po kilem ane banem antap lo olta po wosip God.’ Apta nau demtu i bin wagbaut go tugeda.

Wen demtu bin kese da ples wea God bin spik po Eibram, em bin meke olta ane bin meke dem paiwud stret antap lo olta. Eibram bin taite an ane leg blo Aizak, ane em bin meke em leidaun antap lo dem paiwud, antap lo olta.
Den Eibram bin grabe da naip po kile da boi blo em.
Bat da einzel blo da AntapGod bin singaut po Eibram prom eben kamdaun, ane da einzel bin singaut prapa laudwan diskain, ‘Eibram! Eibram!’ Ane Eibram i ansa, ‘Ai ya God. Wiswei?’
Da einzel i spik, ‘Stap! No kile da boi o meke eniting po em. Ai sabe nau yu prapa lisen ane pole God bikoz yu soem yu redi po kile da boi ane banem antap lo da olta po wosip mi.’

Ane Eibram i bin luk go wansaid ane em bin luk i bin gad wan mansip, pas lo wan smoltri wea on blo em. Eibram bin go ane grabe da mansip ane em bin kile em ane banem antap lo da olta po wosip God. Da sip i bin teke da ples blo da boi.
Den prom dat taim, Eibram i bin kole dat ples ‘Da AntapGod emselp i go gibem’. Ol pipol i stil spik diskaintaim, ‘Lo maunten blo da AntapGod, em i go gibem.’
Da einzel blo da AntapGod i bin singaut gen po Eibram prom eben,
ane God i bin spik, ‘Maiselp ai go meke disting. Diswan i wanem da AntapGod i spik. Bikoz yu bin lisen po mi ane no bin kipe boi blo yu prom mi,

ai go blese yu nau, ane ai go meke ol pamlelain blo yu mina plenti wase dem sta lo skai, ane wase san wea ol sanbis. Ane ol pamlelain blo yu i go prapa smase dem pipol uda no laik dempla ane gobi bos blo siti blo dempla.
Tru ol pamlelain blo yu, God i go blese ebridem pipol wea ert bikoz yu bin mina prapa lisen po mi.’
Den Eibram ane Aizak bin wagbaut gobaigen po demtu sebant, ane dempla ebriwan bin lego go tugeda gobaigen po Bisiba ane Eibram bin stap de wea Bisiba.
Apta wen dem samting ya wea i bin apen, niuz i bin kam po Eibram ane i bin diskain; Milka oman blo Nao, bala blo Eibram i bin gad eit boi pikinini.
Uz bin pas boi pikinini, Buz bala blo em, Kemuel i papa blo dem pipol blo Aram,
Kesed, Azo, Pildas, Zidlap, ane Betuel.
Betuel i bin kam papa blo Ribeka. Milka bin bone dem eit boi pikinini ya po Nao.
Ane da sekan oman blo Nao i bin Ruma uda bin bone po boi pikinini, Teba, Gam, Taias, ane Maka.
